sentences.text: The supplied gold loan FAQ evidence identifies the document and last-updated date, but it does not include any pre-payment instruction text to summarise.
The in-force UCB rule says that, in cases other than the specific exceptions, pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of a UCB.

The same rule says that, for term loans, any pre-payment charge is to be based on the amount being prepaid, and that the charge position must be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and in the KFS where required.
